title: Discord adapter using discord-hono
what: Provide packages/adapter-discord to initiate core work through HTTP Interactions with thread-scoped conversations and durable result delivery. Distinguish this from Gateway mention handling.

acceptance.text: Handle signatures, PING, and commands through discord-hono
Allow only configured guilds and actors; ACK after durable acceptance
Map one thread to one Session DO
Verify retries, expiration, and delivery failure
